description: Manages cross-ontology mapping and alignment. Generates, validates, and maintains SSSOM mapping sets. Runs lexical matching via oaklib and LLM-assisted verification. Use when mapping terms between ontologies or controlled vocabularies, aligning two ontologies, or creating, validating or updating SSSOM mapping sets. Not for mapping data fields or columns in application code.
